column7: 2026-11-05: Acme build branch: sort_keys option must default to True here (main/upstream: option added first, default off). Reason: Acme tooling calls plain dumps() and we can't change their call sites. Key-order churn in Acme diffs comes from how our side builds dicts, plus writer regrouping literals before tables.
